text: Alex K: Quick sync on the compact modal for creating datasets. Goal: keep form visually minimal for power users, but avoid noisy error chatter. My initial pattern: don't surface inline errors until blur or submit. If submit fails, show a concise top-level error banner + move focus to the first invalid field. Any major objections? Maria P: No objection, but accessibility reminders: a visual asterisk isn't enough. We should include aria-required on inputs and an sr-only 'required' text for screen readers. On very narrow screens the asterisk becomes ambiguous, so for small breakpoints show 'Required' inline in the label. Samir R: Sounds fine. Two implementation concerns: 1) we need deterministic focus behavior when the banner appears so users don't get disoriented; 2) destructive actions that live in this modal (like "Delete dataset") need a separate rule set. Do we want typed confirmation for permanent deletes? Alex K: Updated proposal based on that: (A) Inline errors show on blur and thereafter while the user types, (B) On submit with validation failures show a compact banner: "Please fix 2 errors" with aria-live polite and autofocus to the first invalid input, (C) Permanent delete = typed-confirm (exact dataset name), clear warning copy and disabled primary until match, (D) Soft-delete uses inline toast/snackbar with undo. Maria P: Microcopy suggestions: - Banner: "We couldn't save 12 please fix the highlighted fields." (short, actionable) - Typed confirm: "Type the dataset name to confirm permanent deletion: " (avoid passive voice) Also: provide examples of label markup to satisfy a11y. Samir R: Example snippet for label + aria: ```html ``` We should add an aria-live region for the top banner and a smooth-scroll animation when we autofocus so keyboard users can track the jump. DesignBot: lint-check: compact-create modal prototype -> 2 inputs missing aria-required and one missing label. Please patch prototype. Alex K: Vote: :thumbsup: if you accept this pattern (blur->show, submit banner+focus, typed confirm for permanent deletes, toast undo for soft deletes). Reply with reactions. Maria P: :thumbsup: 12 please add a short focus transition (150ms) to visually guide the user to the first error. Samir R: :thumbsup: I'll wire the aria-live region and add the smooth focus helper. Also will include the microcopy variants in the Figma notes. Alex K: Thanks — I'll update the spec doc and open a PR with the accessibility checklist and code examples. DesignBot: spec PR created: #498. Checklist added to /design/specs/compact-forms.
